newsitem.title: USA: Great Western Q3 shr loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Great Western Q3 shr loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q3 includes $188 million assessment for SAIF recapitalization. Excluding assessment, Q3 net was $0.52 a share. 9 months EPS, excluding assessment, was $1.51.
Net interest income totaled $339 million for the 1996 third quarter, compared with $334 million for the year earlier period. Net interest income for the second quarter of 1996 was $352 million.

At September 30, 1996, non-performing assets were $778 million, or 1.79 percent of total assets, compared with $770 million, or 1.76 percent of total assets, at June 30, 1996. Non-performing assets were $762 million, or 1.71 percent of total assets, at September 30, 1995.
Full name of company is Great Western Financial Corp.
